entries.subject: Top-level descriptors
entries.guaranteedBy: Unsigned subtraction-form range validation before every descriptor load or store
entries.limitation: The host must not mutate exported memory during a synchronous call.

entries.subject: Continuation transaction
entries.guaranteedBy: Event and output validation precedes busy, state, sequence, accumulator, and result commits
entries.limitation: Terminal host failure, cancellation, disposal, and numeric faults retain their existing semantics.

entries.subject: Caller aliasing
entries.guaranteedBy: Contained half-open ranges reject event/output and typed payload/output overlap
entries.limitation: Caller input ranges may alias each other when no write is performed through them.

entries.subject: Typed module-private memory
entries.guaranteedBy: Output and response payload ranges exclude embedded request data and result scratch
entries.limitation: The exported memory is not an access-control boundary against direct host stores.

entries.subject: Typed copy
entries.guaranteedBy: The copy helper validates complete source and target ranges and rejects overlap before its loop
entries.limitation: Payload syntax and canonical encoding remain host-codec responsibilities.

entries.subject: Portable ABI compatibility
entries.guaranteedBy: Existing exports, imports, fixed memory, layouts, statuses, manifest version, and runtime sequences are retained
entries.limitation: Artifact bytes change because guards are added; byte identity is not an ABI promise.
